pages.about.creditsDesc: Built on excellent free and open-source software.
pages.about.deno: Runs the companion app and solves YouTube's JavaScript challenges for yt-dlp.
pages.about.desc: Version, credits, legal notes and privacy.
pages.about.ffmpeg: Merges video and audio, converts formats, cuts clips and creates GIFs.
pages.about.notAffiliated: This extension is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.
pages.about.personalUse: For personal use only. Download only videos you own or have permission to save, and respect the creators' copyright and YouTube's Terms of Service.
pages.about.privacy: Your data stays on your computer. The extension only connects to YouTube, and the companion app downloads yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno only from their official releases when you install or update it.
pages.about.privacyCookies: Your YouTube login cookies are only handed to the companion app on this computer, and only when “Use my YouTube login” is turned on.
pages.about.privacyLocal: Settings and the download list are stored only in this browser.
pages.about.privacyNoTracking: No analytics, no tracking, no accounts and no ads.
pages.about.tagline: Download YouTube videos up to 8K/HDR, audio as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV, subtitles, thumbnails, screenshots and player tools.
pages.about.ytdlp: Downloads the video and audio streams from YouTube.
pages.advanced.cardDesc: These settings come from a newer part of the extension and don't have their own controls yet.
pages.advanced.desc: Extra settings without a dedicated page.
pages.advanced.title: Other settings
pages.backup.desc: Save your settings to a file, restore them, or start over.
pages.backup.exportDesc: Download all settings as a JSON file, for example before reinstalling or to use them on another computer.
pages.backup.importDesc: Restore settings from a file you exported earlier. Unknown or invalid values are skipped.
pages.backup.importedSkipped.one: Imported {count} setting, skipped {skipped} unknown or invalid
pages.backup.importedSkipped.other: Imported {count} settings, skipped {skipped} unknown or invalid
pages.backup.invalid: This file isn't a valid settings backup.
pages.backup.resetConfirmText: Every setting goes back to its default value. Your downloads and downloaded files are not affected.
pages.backup.resetDesc: Restore every setting to its default value. Downloads are not affected.
pages.backup.sensitiveCookies: Turn on “Use my YouTube login”: your YouTube login cookies are handed to the companion app for every download.
pages.backup.sensitiveFolder: Save downloads to the network folder {path}, on another computer.
pages.backup.sensitiveSkipped: Imported the other settings. The sensitive ones were skipped.
pages.backup.sensitiveText: This file also changes settings that affect your privacy. Only import them if you made the file yourself or trust where it came from. The other settings are imported either way.
pages.backup.tooBig: This file is too big to be a settings backup.
pages.cleanup.cardDesc: Hide the parts of YouTube you don't need. Changes apply right away in open tabs.
pages.cleanup.desc: A calmer YouTube: hide comments, recommendations, Shorts and more.
pages.cleanup.hideCommentsDesc: Collapses the comment section under videos. You can still show it with one click.
pages.cleanup.hideEndscreenDesc: Removes the video suggestions and cards that cover the end of videos.
pages.cleanup.hideLiveChatDesc: Hides the chat next to live streams and premieres.
pages.cleanup.hideRelatedDesc: Removes the recommendations next to the video.
pages.cleanup.hideShortsDesc: Removes Shorts shelves and the Shorts entry in the menu.
pages.cleanup.title: Clean up YouTube
pages.cmd.cinema: Turn cinema mode on or off
pages.companion.desc: The free companion app downloads videos and audio with yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
pages.companion.techDesc: Useful when you install the companion app manually or ask for help.
pages.companion.updateDesc: YouTube changes often. If downloads start failing, updating yt-dlp usually fixes it.
pages.companion.updateNeedsHost: Available when the companion app is connected.
pages.companion.updateRunning: Updating yt-dlp… This can take a few minutes. You can keep using YouTube meanwhile.
pages.companion.updateUnsupported: This yt-dlp installation can't update itself. Update it with the tool you installed it with (for example pip or winget), or run install.bat again.
pages.downloads.askWhereDesc: Show the “Save as” dialog for screenshots, thumbnails and subtitles saved by the browser.
pages.downloads.audioFormatDesc: Default format of audio downloads. M4A and Opus keep the original quality without re-encoding.
pages.downloads.bitrateDesc: Used for MP3 downloads. Higher means better quality and bigger files.
pages.downloads.chooseNeedsHost: Choosing a folder needs the companion app. You can also type or paste a path.
pages.downloads.codecAutoDesc: AV1 or VP9 when available: the best picture and smaller files.
pages.downloads.codecCompatDesc: H.264 video with AAC audio: plays on any device, TV and video editor.
pages.downloads.codecDesc: Which video codec to pick when several are available.
pages.downloads.containerDesc: MP4 plays everywhere. MKV can hold any codec. WebM is the web's open format.
pages.downloads.cookiesDesc: Lets the companion app download age-restricted and members-only videos that you can watch in this browser.
pages.downloads.cookiesWarn: For each download, your YouTube login cookies are handed to the companion app on this computer. It keeps them in a private file only while the download runs and never sends them anywhere except to YouTube. Turn this on only on a computer you trust.
pages.downloads.desc: Where files are saved, how they are named, their formats, and how downloads behave.
pages.downloads.embedChaptersDesc: Adds the video's chapters as chapter marks.
pages.downloads.embedDesc: Extra information written into downloaded files.
pages.downloads.embedMetadataDesc: Writes the tags that music players and media libraries show.
pages.downloads.embedSubtitlesDesc: Embeds available subtitles (your language and English) into video files.
pages.downloads.embedThumbnailDesc: Adds the video thumbnail as cover art to MP4, MKV and audio files.
pages.downloads.errAbsolute: Enter a full folder path, for example D:\Videos.
pages.downloads.errChars: The path contains characters that aren't allowed in folder names.
pages.downloads.errDirLong: This path is too long. The download folder can have at most {max} characters, so that file names still fit within Windows' path limit.
pages.downloads.errName: A folder name in this path isn't allowed on Windows (for example CON or AUX, or a name that ends with a dot or a space).
pages.downloads.errRelative: Enter a folder name, not a full path.
pages.downloads.maxConcurrentDesc: How many downloads run at the same time. The others wait in the queue.
pages.downloads.notifyDesc: Shows a system notification. Click it to open the file.
pages.downloads.outputDirDesc: Where the companion app saves videos and audio. Leave it empty to use your Downloads folder.
pages.downloads.subfolderDesc: Created inside your Downloads folder. Also used for screenshots, thumbnails and subtitles.
pages.err.noBackground: The extension's background service isn't responding. Try again in a moment.
pages.err.reloaded: The extension was updated. Close and reopen this page.
pages.err.timeout: The extension didn't answer in time. Please try again.
pages.general.desc: Language, theme, the toolbar under videos, and Shorts.
pages.general.languageDesc: Language of the extension. Auto follows your browser.
pages.general.shortsToWatch: Open Shorts in the normal player
pages.general.shortsToWatchDesc: Plays Shorts in the regular video player, with seeking, quality settings and the full toolbar.
pages.general.showOnShortsDesc: Adds a download button next to the like and comment buttons of Shorts.
pages.general.themeDesc: Theme of the extension's panels and pages. Auto matches YouTube's theme on YouTube and your system theme everywhere else.
pages.host.forbiddenText: The companion app is registered for a different extension ID. Run install.bat again to fix it.
pages.host.forbiddenTitle: Access to the companion app is blocked
pages.host.readyText: Video and audio downloads are ready to go.
pages.host.unknownText: The extension's background service didn't answer. Press “Check again” in a moment.
pages.install.desc: A one-time setup that takes about a minute. No admin rights needed.
pages.install.note: The installer uses the yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno already on your computer, or downloads the official versions.
pages.install.step1Text: Go to the folder where you unpacked this extension and open its “companion” folder.
pages.install.step2Text: Double-click install.bat and wait until it says it's done.
pages.install.step3Text: Come back here and press “Check again”. The status turns green when everything works.
pages.install.title: How to install the companion app
pages.media.desc: Default formats for thumbnails and subtitles.
pages.media.srtDesc: The most common format. Works in almost every player.
pages.media.srv3Desc: YouTube's own format, with positions and styling.
pages.media.subLangDesc: Selected first in the subtitles panel when the video has it.
pages.media.subTitle: Subtitles
pages.media.thumbFormatDesc: Original keeps YouTube's file as it is. The other choices convert it.
pages.media.ttmlDesc: XML subtitles used by professional video tools.
pages.media.txtDesc: Only the spoken text, without timestamps. Handy as a transcript.
pages.media.vttDesc: The web's subtitle format, used by browsers and many players.
pages.nav.label: Settings sections
pages.player.autoQualityDesc: Switches every video to this quality, or the closest lower one that is available.
pages.player.boostMaxDesc: Upper limit of the volume boost slider. High values can distort the sound.
pages.player.cinemaDesc: How dark the page around the video gets in cinema mode.
pages.player.desc: Quality, speed, cinema mode and volume boost.
pages.player.rememberSpeedDesc: Keeps the speed you chose for the next videos.
pages.popup.emptyText: Videos and audio you download appear here with their progress.
pages.popup.needsCompanion: Downloads need the free companion app.
pages.popup.noVideoText: Open a video on YouTube to download it from here.
pages.popup.pageNotReady: The YouTube page isn't ready. Reload the tab and try again.
pages.shortcuts.desc: Control the player and downloads from the keyboard.
pages.shortcuts.note: The browser skips suggested shortcuts that clash with its own. You can set or change every shortcut on the browser's shortcuts page.
pages.shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
pages.shots.actionDesc: Tip: Shift+click the screenshot button to copy only.
pages.shots.bothDesc: Saves the file and copies the image.
pages.shots.copyDesc: Paste it straight into a chat or a document.
pages.shots.desc: Format, quality and what happens with screenshots of videos.
pages.shots.formatDesc: PNG is lossless. JPG and WebP make smaller files.
pages.shots.qualityPng: PNG is always saved in full quality.
pages.shots.tip: Screenshots are taken at the video's full resolution and include your brightness, contrast and rotation adjustments.
pages.shots.title: Screenshots
pages.toolbar.desc: Choose which buttons appear in the toolbar under videos.
pages.toolbar.title: Toolbar buttons
pages.trouble.bot: Downloads fail with “Sign in to confirm you're not a bot” or an age check? Turn on “Use my YouTube login” under Downloads.
pages.trouble.moved: Moved the project folder, or use another browser (Edge, Brave…)? Load the “extension” folder again on the browser's extensions page (Load unpacked). Run install.bat again only if the companion app still shows as not installed.
pages.trouble.restart: Still “not installed” after installing? Close all browser windows, open the browser again and press “Check again”.
pages.trouble.smartscreen: Windows SmartScreen or your antivirus may warn about install.bat. Choose “More info” → “Run anyway”, or allow it in your antivirus.
pages.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
pages.trouble.uninstall: To remove the companion app, run uninstall.bat from the same folder.
pages.trouble.update: All downloads suddenly fail? YouTube changed something. Press “Update yt-dlp” above.
